objective: Auditar si Tablajeria puede operar de forma autonoma dentro de EDARSAHUB, sin depender de sistemas legacy. Revisar proceso completo: alta y edicion de plantillas, insumo base, derivados, publicacion, autorizacion, ordenes, resultados, cierre, entradas y salidas, costeo, poliza, RBAC y flujo de autorizacion. No modificar codigo, datos, permisos ni Produccion.

queries.name: tablajeria_autonomy_columns
queries.sql: SELECT TABLE_NAME, COLUMN_NAME, DATA_TYPE FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS WHERE TABLE_NAME IN ('Operaciones_Tablaje_Plantillas','Operaciones_Tablaje_PlantillasDetalle','Operaciones_Tablaje_Ordenes','Operaciones_Tablaje_OrdenesDetalle','Tablajeria_MovimientosInventario','Tablajeria_CosteoProduccion','Tablajeria_CosteoDetalle','Tablajeria_ConfigContable','Tablajeria_PolizasContables','Tablajeria_PolizasDetalle') ORDER BY TABLE_NAME, ORDINAL_POSITION

queries.name: tablajeria_status_distribution
queries.sql: SELECT 'plantillas' AS entidad, Estatus AS estatus, COUNT(*) AS total FROM dbo.Operaciones_Tablaje_Plantillas GROUP BY Estatus UNION ALL SELECT 'ordenes' AS entidad, EstatusOrden AS estatus, COUNT(*) AS total FROM dbo.Operaciones_Tablaje_Ordenes GROUP BY EstatusOrden ORDER BY entidad, estatus

queries.name: tablajeria_costing_flags_search
queries.sql: SELECT TABLE_NAME, COLUMN_NAME, DATA_TYPE FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS WHERE TABLE_NAME LIKE '%Tablaj%' AND (COLUMN_NAME LIKE '%Costo%' OR COLUMN_NAME LIKE '%Prorrat%' OR COLUMN_NAME LIKE '%Fijo%' OR COLUMN_NAME LIKE '%Movimiento%' OR COLUMN_NAME LIKE '%Inventariable%' OR COLUMN_NAME LIKE '%Merma%' OR COLUMN_NAME LIKE '%Autoriz%') ORDER BY TABLE_NAME, COLUMN_NAME

queries.name: tablajeria_rbac_schema_candidates
queries.sql: SELECT TABLE_NAME, COLUMN_NAME, DATA_TYPE FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS WHERE TABLE_NAME LIKE 'Usuario_%' AND (COLUMN_NAME LIKE '%Modulo%' OR COLUMN_NAME LIKE '%Permiso%' OR COLUMN_NAME LIKE '%Accion%' OR COLUMN_NAME LIKE '%Rol%' OR COLUMN_NAME LIKE '%Clave%') ORDER BY TABLE_NAME, ORDINAL_POSITION

queries.name: tablajeria_permissions_candidates
queries.sql: SELECT TABLE_NAME, COLUMN_NAME, DATA_TYPE FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS WHERE TABLE_NAME LIKE '%Permis%' OR TABLE_NAME LIKE '%Modulo%' OR TABLE_NAME LIKE '%Rol%' ORDER BY TABLE_NAME, ORDINAL_POSITION
